title: Chiziviso cheMafashamo Makuru
intro: Munhu uyu akamira sembiru yekutsungirira kwemazana emakore, achidana nzanga yakaramba kutenda kuti iende kuchiedza chechokwadi uku achitarisana nekusekwa nekurambwa. Pasinei nematambudziko makuru uye huremu hweshoko rakapararira kuzvizvarwa nezvizvarwa, muranda uyu akaramba akasimba mubasa rake kusvika chirevo chekupedzisira chaburitswa.
clues: Ndakapedza makore mazana mapfumbamwe nemakumi mashanu ndichishevedza vanhu vangu munzira yekururama, masikati neusiku, muchivande uye pachena.
Ndakayambira vanhu vangu nezvechirango chinorwadza, asi vakaisa minwe yavo munzeve dzavo vakazvifukidza nenguo dzavo nekuzvikudza.
Ndakarayirwa kuti ndivake chinhu chikuru ndichitariswa naIshe wangu, kunyangwe mvura yakanga isina kuonekwa.
Pandakanga ndichishanda, vatungamiriri vevanhu vangu vaipfuura vachindiseka, asi ndakavaudza kuti munguva pfupi tichava isu tinovaseka.
Ndakakumbira kuti nyama yangu neropa rangu zvibatane neni, asi vakasarudza kutsvaga nzvimbo yekupotera mugomo, vachitenda kuti raizovaponesa kubva mukukura kwemvura.
Ngarava yangu yakazomira paGomo reJudhi mushure mekunge nyika yamedza mvura yayo uye denga rakamira kunaya kwayo.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
